task.title: Stabilize strict provider readiness after dev restart

scope.owned_layer: Nonprod dev deployment strict readiness validation retry and assertion contract
composes_with: PFG-DEV-INTEGRATION-20260820 dev Compose and stack deployment

behavioral_proof.retry_window: Bounded post-restart retry loop with DEV_BFF_AUTH_READINESS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (default: 120s) and DEV_BFF_AUTH_READINESS_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS (default: 2s)
behavioral_proof.transient_recovery: Transient OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT or providerReady=false resolves to success on subsequent poll without workflow redispatch
behavioral_proof.fail_closed_expiry: Permanent non-ready expires at bounded deadline with sanitized error evidence and exits non-zero
behavioral_proof.exact_sha_and_auth: Exact commit SHA matching and strict auth mode/verifier checks remain strictly enforced on every readiness sample
